scope: Full original Part II prerequisite diagnosis, with current connected changed passages read again; not a fresh correctness review of every original scientific claim. Root owns global and backmatter coverage.

section_adoption_checks.reason: Physical pathway follows visible foundations eye anatomy and persistence integrator teaching. Proposed attractor source is distinguished from recording inference.
Recording unit, search coil, segment selection and gain calibration are explained before the forward model.
Position, velocity, acceleration, fitted coefficients and lead are interpreted before inversion. Test and p value are explained before significance interpretation.
Causal filter and impulse response precede factorization, kernel, spike convolution and gain checks. Optional derivations expand results already explained in the main text.
Best linear prediction and residual variance are derived before the independent population bound and its interpretation.
Centered displacement components, unit gain and lack of covariance are set before covariance fraction; correlation identity and weighting are derived before reported common share.
MSD and distinct-time measurement independence precede the constant offset calculation and subtraction limitations.

Stationary process, white input and low pass filter are introduced before plateau inference; Brownian command and weighted-increment integral are explained before velocity covariance and filtered diffusion MSD.

Opposing populations and rate response precede scaled spike and synaptic closure; fixed-point condition precedes drift interpretation. Motor and delayed feedback rules are interpreted before model comparison.
CV reminder precedes construction from retained Poisson events; renewal count variance precedes CV squared scaling. Earlier information chapter supplies J and information-diffusion bound.
Figure table follows the specific model and measurement calculations. Spearman rank correlation is introduced before interpreting the supplementary check.
Limits distinguish shared source inference, timing evidence and sufficient circuit model, all established earlier.
Input map, threshold, connected fields, covariance and distance scale precede crossing calculation; candidate concern is essential GP finite-dimensional meaning retained only in optional fold.
Local tangent and narrow vertical band counting precede Kac-Rice integral. Height-slope independence is expressly stated before evaluating it. Endpoint correction is derived before further inference.

Occupied length per distance and crossing density precede field/gap means and inversion. Rare independent excursion assumptions precede Poisson counts; silent-cell conditioning is derived before application.

Hessian, Gaussian conditional mean and high peak assumptions precede parabola and excess-height law. Higher-dimensional peak-count factor is introduced at use and its ratio limit explained; later derivation is supporting detail.

Unit ball volume and gamma function precede size conversion and density transformation. Mean and units precede scale comparisons; Weibull label table is followed immediately by definition of the already explicit law.
Restriction of joint Gaussian values and covariance explains slice predictions; hit probability and off-centre cuts are distinguished before comparison.
Crossing selection weighting precedes Rayleigh boundary slope density; optional width check uses already taught parabola and slope law.
Components, holes, Euler characteristic and Betti counts precede examples. Critical points and Morse signed counts precede determinant density. Boundary face factors precede finite-box formulas.
Table distinguishes fitting from tests using established quantities. Skew, excess kurtosis, lognormal, likelihood and processing choices are explained at their first dependent discussion.
Fixed spatial input profiles and weight statistics precede summation, Gaussian limit conditions and covariance. Translation/coverage assumptions precede stationarity and example covariance width.
Map, stored coordinate and observed movement are distinguished before comparison table.
Fixed tuning and common displacement assumptions precede linearization and expected-rate covariance.
Numeric example uses previously derived slopes and displacement variance; sign is interpreted without treating it as wiring evidence.
Each evidence comparison relies on preceding calculations and preserves its assumptions.

Related studies are brief context rather than unexplained machinery required by the next calculation; CA1/CA3, grid cell and plasticity have earlier foundations, path integration and dendrite are defined locally.
Joint test sequence uses established tuning, covariance, diffusion and filtering concepts; no new mathematical prerequisite is required.

Mean and covariance then describe the map statistics, and regularity assumptions precede derivatives. At crossing evaluation, the visible zero-covariance independence statement supplies the required implication before the density is factored.

Previously taught convolution turns that into the overlap integral; stationarity and finite overlap then give the plateau. The local reminder keeps the assumption usable without following the link again.

chapter_order_comparison.short_foundation_moves: Moving only the finite-dimensional GP definition from its fold and the general white-noise definition to its earlier equation use supplies the needed foundations. Whole-chapter moves would add model machinery before the observed question requires it and would disrupt the evidence-to-mechanism sequence.
chapter_order_comparison.outcome: No chapter swap needed. Keep detailed proofs and optional mathematical expansions folded.

concept_index_limits: Relations use exact current extracted passage IDs and zero-based character spans, verified against current text.
The extractor omits displayed equations; direct source inspection supplies equation coverage in diagnosis and stage records. The JSON relations do not claim exhaustive indexing of every equation.
Only Part II sections, including previously read chapter openings, are marked reviewed. Earlier Ch6 white-noise teaching is recorded as one relation, not whole-section coverage.
Adoption is based on original direct passage judgments plus unchanged current file/section/sidecar hashes and checked connections. A hash alone is not a semantic review.
